deadline.value: Priority consideration by December 15; applications close February 1. The program admits only in fall.

app_fee.value: The department states a $67 application fee for all applicants.
app_fee.quote: An application fee of $67 is required from all applicants.

gre_general.value: The Biology graduate programs do not currently require the GRE.
gre_general.quote: The graduate programs in the Biology department at PSU do not currently require the GRE.

gre_subject.value: Biology has no subject GRE; the department says the GRE is not required.

supervisor.value: Applicants must contact and interview with at least one prospective faculty advisor before applying.
supervisor.quote: Contacted and interviewed with at least one but preferably three potential tenure-track faculty advisors.

funding.value: The department offers funding to most students, often as teaching assistants.
funding.quote: We are proud to offer funding to most students who also have the opportunity to serve as teaching assistants.

entry_route.value: The pages checked do not say whether a bachelor's alone is enough for the PhD.

notes: Biology Master's/PhD is one combined admissions page; only the PhD track is relevant here.
